value: This abstract summarizes the GitHub profile of Niki Vazou, showcasing their popular open-source repositories that predominantly focus on functional programming and formal verification. The listed projects highlight significant work with Liquid Haskell, a system for refinement types, to facilitate robust theorem proving within the Haskell ecosystem. Additional contributions include explorations in type theory, derivation of optimized definitions based on specifications, and development of verified parallelized algorithms. Overall, the profile serves as a central hub for Niki Vazou's technical contributions to advanced programming language theory and practical applications of formal methods.
